scope: Group appearance and keyboard settings more tightly
limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. Native OS input, assistive technology and Rust command integration were not exercised.

conversation--settings-compact-dark.png.task: Choose appearance and consult keyboard commands in an orderly compact dialog.
conversation--settings-compact-dark.png.observations: Opened full frame: the selected appearance now matches the rendered theme, each miniature preview includes its composer, and motion/Done are visible. Desktop shortcuts align in a secondary column. Compact shortcuts require a separate scrolled capture; this frame only depicts appearance and motion.
